title: BiomedicalImaging CellBenchmarkPicker

stats.done_summary: Successfully completed the BiomedicalImaging CellBenchmarkPicker task. Selected 4 diverse datasets (D0000, D0003, D0007, D0013) from the cell benchmark registry and trained a consistent MLP baseline architecture (2-layer: 64→32 hidden units with ReLU) on pre-extracted tabular features. Reported hold-out Dice scores: D0000=0.175, D0003=0.045, D0007=0.091, D0013=0.261. Results show substantial gaps from published SOTA (0.700-0.862), highlighting challenges of segmentation from anonymized tabular features. Generated 5 visualizations and comprehensive research report with methodology, results, and discussion.
